scope: Canonical model concepts shared across prototype/mra-v0 and prototype/web-v1

contextualActions.shoot_photo: Exclusive to Daniela De Rossi. Requires water > 0 and food > 0. Subject to cooldown and session cap.

intentionalDivergences.difference: web-v1 uses player-facing canonical outcome labels, while mra-v0 keeps historical compressed classes.
web-v1 stage/route abstraction differs from mra-v0 low/mid/high bands and does not require identical labels.
